description: Read the authorized workspace account inventory from the Meta mirror, with optional level, status, parent, and ID cursor filters.

account_id.description: Advertising account ID available to the authorized workspace.

adset_id.description: Filter to objects under this parent ad set ID.

after_id.description: Database ID cursor from the previous page; continue with its last object ID.

campaign_id.description: Filter to objects under this parent campaign ID.

effective_status.description: Filter by Meta effective status, such as ACTIVE, PAUSED, or ARCHIVED.

level.description: Limit results to campaign, adset, or ad objects.

limit.description: Maximum complete objects, from 1 to 200; defaults to 25 and may return fewer to fit the JSON budget. Account summary totals are present on every page.

workspace_id.description: Workspace ID returned by list_workspaces. Required when this credential reaches multiple workspaces.

name: get_account_inventory
title: Get account inventory
